title: Foundations of Physiotherapy: Movement, Biomechanics and Assessment

items.q: Which statement correctly defines Ligament?
o: striated voluntary muscle that produces movement by pulling on bones
the fibrous band that joins bone to bone and checks excessive movement
the history a patient gives about symptoms, function and previous problems
a trained support worker who carries out delegated treatment tasks under supervision
items.s: Ligament: the fibrous band that joins bone to bone and checks excessive movement. The other options describe Subjective assessment, Physiotherapy assistant, Skeletal muscle.

items.s: Isotonic contraction: a contraction that changes muscle length while tension remains fairly constant. The other options describe Palpation, Proprioception, Physiotherapy.
